label: Landfall planning base
note: US$ planning assumptions for a small first test, set by Landfall (27 Oct 2026). They are not quotes, rates or sourced figures. Locally bought items are scaled by the country's price level (price_levels.json); the brand's own goods and their freight are not.

retail:STOCK.note: a first consignment of about 100 units at about US$15 landed cost each

retail:SHIPPING.note: one boxed shipment to the shop

popup:HIRE_FEE.note: a small shared or gallery space for a weekend

popup:DEPOSIT.note: a refundable damage or booking deposit

popup:STAFF.note: two people on the stand for two eight-hour days

popup:FIXTURE.note: tables, signage and display for one stand

popup:SHIPPING.note: one boxed shipment of stock to the venue

popup:PERMIT.note: one temporary event or vendor permit

creator:CREATOR_FEE.note: one sponsored post by a small local creator

creator:STOCK.note: product sent to creators, at about US$15 landed cost each

community:OTHER.note: a contribution to one local community event

community:STOCK.note: product for the event, at about US$15 landed cost each

digital:MEDIA_SPEND.note: a small paid-social test; the days follow the plan's digital scenario
